payload.title: Split Babulus into a public open-core app and a private Papyrus marketing site
payload.description: Separate the public open-core Babulus app (this repo) from a private companion repo and Papyrus-powered marketing site for babul.us, following Papyrus-web, Kanbus-web, Cyclotron-web and Chattic.us-web. Target: babul.us = marketing site, app.babul.us = product app. Private planning lives in the private repo, not on this public board.
